title: Creativity Contests: An Experimental Investigation of Eliciting Employee Creativity
sources_checked: Author-prepared Data for Analysis (2022-10-18).dta, exact local package source named in output/executions/packages/jar-a244ca32a401/local_inputs.json; SHA-256 380068acc293ed69fea04f91745d80a16fef8c8ed167d17c049acd8994dd1feb. Metadata-only inspection: 12,994 rows and 50 columns; zero Stata %t date/time formats and no calendar date/year/month/period field. The name IdeaTimeThinkingNum is an elapsed-duration measure; YearsofEducation is education, not observation year.

Accepted author package inventory at historical artifact package: the prepared analysis DTA, the author do-file, and BLS datasheet.pdf. No raw survey exports or repeat-experiment observations are included in this named package; this is a package-bound observation, not a claim that no copies exist elsewhere.

Accepted analysis code: work/full_analysis_1242_1922.do opens the fixed prepared DTA at line 2; Table 3 participation code begins at line 225 and Table 5 quality code at line 499. The selected analysis section has no calendar observation index or date-window filter.

Assigned sample and model records: output/samples/records/jar-a244ca32a401.json and output/models/records/jar-a244ca32a401.json. They identify the experiment as one primary collection, give no calendar start/end, and map participation to 941 invitees (Table 3, p. 21) and idea quality to 527 submissions (Table 5, p. 28).
changes: No calendar bounds, source shifts, or model terms were changed. The accepted estimates use fixed participant and idea samples from a one-time randomized contest experiment, so a five-calendar-year pooled window is not defined and no scientific replay was launched.
limitations: The paper/sample record dates no observation clock: the three experiment stages take four months (paper p. 14) and idea collection lasts seven days (p. 15), but both are durations, not calendar endpoints. The prepared file and selected code contain no calendar date/year/period variable; original_begin, original_end, requested_end, supported_end, and last_added therefore remain null.

The accepted analysis-only branch reads the author-prepared 2022-10-18 dataset and bypasses upstream raw survey construction. The named package inventory supplies no later or repeated experiment observations. No date coverage or current-vintage continuation can be established for this fixed design.

The predecessor’s formatting-only gap G_ESTOUT1_FORMATTED_TABLES remains carried forward: the 13 author estout1 tables were not produced because that implementation was unavailable; the accepted model fits and Figure 1 were retained. This gap does not create an extendable time dimension.

analyses.reason: Not applicable, established at preflight. These three fits estimate usefulness, novelty, and creativity for 527 ideas submitted in the same one-time randomized contest. The accepted analysis reads the fixed prepared DTA and filters to idea observations, with no date/year/period index. The idea set is closed after the experiment, so no five-year pooled extension exists; no extended fit or native launch is appropriate.
